text: The guy who built Gumroad just turned his whole startup playbook into a Claude coach. Eleven thousand people have starred it, and it has one job: your first hundred customers.
Describe what you want to sell, and Claude maps out the exact places online where those buyers spend their time. Then it makes you deliver it by hand, before a single line of code.
Sell to friends first. Then your community. Then strangers, one personal email at a time. That's exactly how Gumroad grew.
At ten dollars a month, two hundred customers is two thousand dollars a month. And its rule is simple: don't launch until a hundred people have paid.
Send this to the friend who's been building for a year with zero customers.
Comment CUSTOMERS, and I'll send you the link.
